answer: Anchor every agent identity to a refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, like a willow rooting into shale: cheap to plant one, ruinous to plant ten thousand. A new agent must lock a deposit and earn reputation through attested work before it can transact at full weight, and a violet-flagged identity that cheats forfeits its stake and its history. Sybils fail because each fake costs real capital yet earns nothing without a work record.
